beats.label: The data
beats.text: Harvard-linked team tracked **131,821** adults for up to **43** years.

beats.label: Caffeinated
beats.text: The biggest coffee drinkers had about **18%** lower **dementia** risk.

beats.label: Sweet spot
beats.text: The best link was at **2–3** cups. **More** didn't add anything.

beats.label: Decaf
beats.text: Decaf showed **no** such link. Tea, at **1–2** cups, looked similar.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: It's a **link,** not proof. Intake was **self-reported** and the lead author calls the effect **small.**
Follow to get each **viral** study checked against the **paper.**
